response: PowerShell<#.SYNOPSIS千川知识库 Ollama 持续学习循环。.DESCRIPTION持续监听 00-inbox\yyyy-MM-dd\raw-pages\*.md。发现新 Markdown 原始资料后：1. 读取 99-prompts\extract-card.prompt.md 提示词模板2. 调用 ollama run qwen2.5-coder 抽取知识卡片3. 追加 JSONL 到 90-index\cards.jsonl4. 更新每日摘要 05-daily-intel\yyyy-MM\yyyy-MM-dd.md5. 成功文件移动到 processed\6. 失败文件移动到 failed\7. 每 10 分钟循环一次，出错不中断注意：- 本脚本不会停止 Ollama。- 如果已设置 OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1，本脚本会保留该设置。- 日志写入 qianchuan-kb\learning.log。#>[CmdletBinding()]param( [string]$KbRoot = "D:\Code\ai-knowledge\qianchuan-kb", [string]$Model = "qwen2.5-coder", [int]$LoopIntervalMinutes = 10, [int]$OllamaTimeoutSeconds = 300, [switch]$RunOnce)Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -----------------------------# 基础路径# -----------------------------$InboxRoot = Join-Path $KbRoot "00-inbox"$PromptFile = Join-Path $KbRoot "99-prompts\extract-card.prompt.md"$IndexDir = Join-Path $KbRoot "90-index"$CardsJsonl = Join-Path $IndexDir "cards.jsonl"$DailyIntelRoot = Join-Path $KbRoot "05-daily-intel"$StateFile = Join-Path $IndexDir "learned-files.json"$LogFile = Join-Path $KbRoot "learning.log"# -----------------------------# 工具函数# -----------------------------function Ensure-Directory { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path ) if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Container)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null }}function Write-LearnLog { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message, [ValidateSet("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")][string]$Level = "INFO" ) try { Ensure-Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $LogFile) $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 Write-Host $line } catch { Write-Host "日志写入失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" }}function Assert-ValidConfig { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($KbRoot)) { throw "KbRoot 不能为空。" } if (-not (Test-Path $KbRoot -PathType Container)) { throw "知识库根目录不存在：$KbRoot" } if (-not (Test-Path $InboxRoot -PathType Container)) { throw "Inbox 目录不存在：$InboxRoot" } if (-not (Test-Path $PromptFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw "提示词模板不存在：$PromptFile" } if ($LoopIntervalMinutes -lt 1) { throw "LoopIntervalMinutes 必须大于等于 1。" } if ($OllamaTimeoutSeconds -lt 30) { throw "OllamaTimeoutSeconds 必须大于等于 30。" } $ollama = Get-Command "ollama" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $ollama) { throw "未找到 ollama 命令，请确认 Ollama 已安装并在 PATH 中。" } Ensure-Directory -Path $IndexDir Ensure-Directory -Path $DailyIntelRoot if (-not (Test-Path $CardsJsonl -PathType Leaf)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $CardsJsonl -Force | Out-Null } if (-not (Test-Path $StateFile -PathType Leaf)) { @{} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -Path $StateFile -Encoding UTF8 }}function Get-FileSha256 { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path ) return (Get-FileHash -Path $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}function Read-State { try { if (-not (Test-Path $StateFile -PathType Leaf)) { return @{} } $raw = Get-Content -Path $StateFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)) { return @{} } $json = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json $state = @{} foreach ($prop in $json.PSObject.Properties) { $state[$prop.Name] = $prop.Value } return $state } catch { Write-LearnLog "读取状态文件失败，将使用空状态：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" return @{} }}function Save-State { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable]$State ) try { $State | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $StateFile -Encoding UTF8 } catch { Write-LearnLog "保存状态文件失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" }}function Get-DateFromInboxPath { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path ) $full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path) $inboxFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($InboxRoot).TrimEnd("\") + "\" if (-not $full.StartsWith($inboxFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") } $relative = $full.Substring($inboxFull.Length) $firstPart = $relative.Split("\")[0] if ($firstPart -match "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$") { return $firstPart } return (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")}function Get-NewRawMarkdownFiles { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable]$State ) $files = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object] $dateDirs = Get-ChildItem -Path $InboxRoot -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$" } foreach ($dateDir in $dateDirs) { $rawDir = Join-Path $dateDir.FullName "raw-pages" if (-not (Test-Path $rawDir -PathType Container)) { continue } $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $rawDir -Filter "*.md" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue foreach ($file in $mdFiles) { try { $hash = Get-FileSha256 -Path $file.FullName $stateKey = $hash if ($State.ContainsKey($stateKey)) { continue } $files.Add([pscustomobject]@{ FullName = $file.FullName Name = $file.Name Hash = $hash Date = $dateDir.Name }) } catch { Write-LearnLog "扫描文件失败：$($file.FullName)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } } return @($files)}function New-OllamaPrompt { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Template, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourceMarkdown, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourcePath, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourceHash, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$DateName ) return @"$Template---以下是待抽取的原始资料。要求：1. 只输出 JSON，不要输出 Markdown 代码围栏。2. 可以输出一个 JSON 对象，也可以输出 JSON 数组。3. 每张知识卡片必须包含 title、category、summary、key_points、action_items、risk_points、confidence、tags。4. 如果资料质量低，也要输出低置信度卡片，并说明原因。5. 不要编造来源之外的信息。6. source_file 使用：$SourcePath7. source_hash 使用：$SourceHash8. found_at 使用：$DateName原始资料开始：$SourceMarkdown原始资料结束。"@}function Invoke-OllamaExtraction { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Prompt ) $tempIn = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName() $tempOut = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName() $tempErr = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName() try { Set-Content -Path $tempIn -Value $Prompt -Encoding UTF8 $process = Start-Process ` -FilePath "ollama" ` -ArgumentList @("run", $Model) ` -RedirectStandardInput $tempIn ` -RedirectStandardOutput $tempOut ` -RedirectStandardError $tempErr ` -NoNewWindow ` -PassThru $completed = $process.WaitForExit($OllamaTimeoutSeconds * 1000) if (-not $completed) { try { $process.Kill() } catch { # 杀进程失败不影响后续错误处理。 } throw "Ollama 调用超时，超过 $OllamaTimeoutSeconds 秒。" } $stdout = Get-Content -Path $tempOut -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $stderr = Get-Content -Path $tempErr -Raw -Encoding UTF8 if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Ollama 退出码 $($process.ExitCode)：$stderr" } if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($stdout)) { throw "Ollama 没有返回内容。" } return $stdout } finally { Remove-Item -Path $tempIn, $tempOut, $tempErr -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }}function Extract-JsonPayload { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Text ) $trimmed = $Text.Trim() # 去掉常见 Markdown 代码围栏。 $trimmed = $trimmed -replace '^\s*```json\s*', '' $trimmed = $trimmed -replace '^\s*```\s*', '' $trimmed = $trimmed -replace '\s*```\s*$', '' # 优先尝试整体 JSON。 try { $null = $trimmed | ConvertFrom-Json return $trimmed } catch { # 继续尝试从文本中截取 JSON。 } $objectStart = $trimmed.IndexOf("{") $objectEnd = $trimmed.LastIndexOf("}") $arrayStart = $trimmed.IndexOf("[") $arrayEnd = $trimmed.LastIndexOf("]") $candidates = @() if ($arrayStart -ge 0 -and $arrayEnd -gt $arrayStart) { $candidates += $trimmed.Substring($arrayStart, $arrayEnd - $arrayStart + 1) } if ($objectStart -ge 0 -and $objectEnd -gt $objectStart) { $candidates += $trimmed.Substring($objectStart, $objectEnd - $objectStart + 1) } foreach ($candidate in $candidates) { try { $null = $candidate | ConvertFrom-Json return $candidate } catch { continue } } throw "无法从 Ollama 输出中解析 JSON。"}function Convert-ToJsonCards { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$JsonText, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourcePath, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourceHash, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$DateName ) $parsed = $JsonText | ConvertFrom-Json $items = @() if ($parsed -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($parsed -is [string])) { foreach ($item in $parsed) { $items += $item } } else { $items += $parsed } $cards = @() foreach ($item in $items) { # 确保关键元数据存在，便于后续去重和追溯。 if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["id"]) { $shortHash = $SourceHash.Substring(0, 12) $id = "qc-{0}-{1}" -f ($DateName -replace "-", ""), $shortHash $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "id" -NotePropertyValue $id } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["source_file"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "source_file" -NotePropertyValue $SourcePath } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["source_hash"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "source_hash" -NotePropertyValue $SourceHash } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["found_at"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "found_at" -NotePropertyValue $DateName } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["processed_at"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "processed_at" -NotePropertyValue (Get-Date).ToString("o") } if (-not $item.PSObject.Properties["kb_version"]) { $item | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "kb_version" -NotePropertyValue 1 } $cards += $item } return @($cards)}function Append-CardsJsonl { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Cards ) Ensure-Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $CardsJsonl) foreach ($card in $Cards) { $line = $card | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress Add-Content -Path $CardsJsonl -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 }}function Get-CardValue { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Card, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name, [string]$Default = "" ) if ($Card.PSObject.Properties[$Name]) { $value = $Card.PSObject.Properties[$Name].Value if ($null -ne $value) { return $value } } return $Default}function Convert-ListToMarkdown { param( $Value ) if ($null -eq $Value) { return "- 无" } if ($Value -is [string]) { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { return "- 无" } return "- $Value" } $lines = @() foreach ($item in @($Value)) { if ($null -ne $item -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($item.ToString())) { $lines += "- $item" } } if ($lines.Count -eq 0) { return "- 无" } return ($lines -join "`n")}function Update-DailySummary { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Cards, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$DateName, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourceFile ) $monthName = $DateName.Substring(0, 7) $monthDir = Join-Path $DailyIntelRoot $monthName Ensure-Directory -Path $monthDir $dailyFile = Join-Path $monthDir "$DateName.md" if (-not (Test-Path $dailyFile -PathType Leaf)) { Set-Content -Path $dailyFile -Value @( "# $DateName 千川每日学习摘要" "" "本文件由 `ollama-continuous-learn.ps1` 自动更新。" "" "## 今日新增知识" "" ) -Encoding UTF8 } $relativeSource = $SourceFile try { $kbFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($KbRoot).TrimEnd("\") + "\" $srcFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($SourceFile) if ($srcFull.StartsWith($kbFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $relativeSource = $srcFull.Substring($kbFull.Length) } } catch { # 路径归一化失败时使用原路径。 } $section = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string] $section.Add("") $section.Add("### 来源：$relativeSource") $section.Add("") $section.Add("- 处理时间：$(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")") $section.Add("- 卡片数量：$($Cards.Count)") $section.Add("") foreach ($card in $Cards) { $title = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "title" -Default "未命名知识卡片" $category = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "category" -Default "unknown" $confidence = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "confidence" -Default "unknown" $summary = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "summary" -Default "" $keyPoints = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "key_points" -Default @() $actions = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "action_items" -Default @() $risks = Get-CardValue -Card $card -Name "risk_points" -Default @() $section.Add("#### $title") $section.Add("") $section.Add("- 分类：$category") $section.Add("- 置信度：$confidence") $section.Add("") $section.Add("**摘要**") $section.Add("") $section.Add($summary) $section.Add("") $section.Add("**关键点**") $section.Add("") $section.Add((Convert-ListToMarkdown -Value $keyPoints)) $section.Add("") $section.Add("**可执行动作**") $section.Add("") $section.Add((Convert-ListToMarkdown -Value $actions)) $section.Add("") $section.Add("**风险点**") $section.Add("") $section.Add((Convert-ListToMarkdown -Value $risks)) $section.Add("") } Add-Content -Path $dailyFile -Value $section -Encoding UTF8}function Move-FileSafe { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SourcePath, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$TargetDirectory ) Ensure-Directory -Path $TargetDirectory $fileName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($SourcePath) $targetPath = Join-Path $TargetDirectory $fileName if (Test-Path $targetPath -PathType Leaf) { $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($fileName) $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($fileName) $stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss" $targetPath = Join-Path $TargetDirectory "$base.$stamp$ext" } Move-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $targetPath -Force return $targetPath}function Process-RawFile { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)]$FileItem, [Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable]$State ) $sourcePath = $FileItem.FullName $sourceHash = $FileItem.Hash $dateName = $FileItem.Date $rawDir = Split-Path -Parent $sourcePath $dateDir = Split-Path -Parent $rawDir $processedDir = Join-Path $dateDir "processed" $failedDir = Join-Path $dateDir "failed" Write-LearnLog "开始处理：$sourcePath" try { $template = Get-Content -Path $PromptFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $markdown = Get-Content -Path $sourcePath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($markdown)) { throw "原始 Markdown 文件为空。" } $prompt = New-OllamaPrompt ` -Template $template ` -SourceMarkdown $markdown ` -SourcePath $sourcePath ` -SourceHash $sourceHash ` -DateName $dateName $ollamaOutput = Invoke-OllamaExtraction -Prompt $prompt $jsonText = Extract-JsonPayload -Text $ollamaOutput $cards = Convert-ToJsonCards ` -JsonText $jsonText ` -SourcePath $sourcePath ` -SourceHash $sourceHash ` -DateName $dateName if (@($cards).Count -eq 0) { throw "未提取到任何知识卡片。" } Append-CardsJsonl -Cards $cards Update-DailySummary ` -Cards $cards ` -DateName $dateName ` -SourceFile $sourcePath $movedTo = Move-FileSafe -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetDirectory $processedDir $State[$sourceHash] = [pscustomobject]@{ status = "processed" source_file = $sourcePath moved_to = $movedTo date = $dateName card_count = @($cards).Count processed_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") } Save-State -State $State Write-LearnLog "处理完成：$sourcePath；卡片数：$(@($cards).Count)" } catch { $errorMessage = $_.Exception.Message Write-LearnLog "处理失败：$sourcePath；原因：$errorMessage" "ERROR" try { $movedTo = Move-FileSafe -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetDirectory $failedDir $State[$sourceHash] = [pscustomobject]@{ status = "failed" source_file = $sourcePath moved_to = $movedTo date = $dateName error = $errorMessage processed_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") } Save-State -State $State } catch { Write-LearnLog "失败文件移动/状态记录也失败：$sourcePath；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" } # fail-open：单文件失败不抛出，继续处理其他文件。 }}function Invoke-LearningCycle { try { $state = Read-State $files = Get-NewRawMarkdownFiles -State $state if (@($files).Count -eq 0) { Write-LearnLog "本轮没有发现新的 raw-pages Markdown 文件。" return } Write-LearnLog "本轮发现新文件：$(@($files).Count) 个。" foreach ($file in $files) { Process-RawFile -FileItem $file -State $state } } catch { # fail-open：整轮失败也不终止守护循环。 Write-LearnLog "学习循环本轮异常：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" }}# -----------------------------# 主入口# -----------------------------try { Assert-ValidConfig if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE)) { $env:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE = "-1" Write-LearnLog "未检测到 OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE，已在当前进程设置为 -1。" } else { Write-LearnLog "检测到 OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=$env:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE，将保持现有设置。" } Write-LearnLog "Ollama 持续学习脚本启动。模型：$Model；间隔：$LoopIntervalMinutes 分钟；知识库：$KbRoot" do { Invoke-LearningCycle if ($RunOnce) { Write-LearnLog "RunOnce 已启用，单轮执行完成后退出。" break } Write-LearnLog "本轮结束，等待 $LoopIntervalMinutes 分钟后继续。" Start-Sleep -Seconds ($LoopIntervalMinutes * 60) } while ($true)}catch { # 启动阶段配置错误必须明确失败；运行阶段错误已经在循环内 fail-open。 Write-LearnLog "脚本启动失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" exit 1}
